name: okf-knowledge-base
description: Agent-operated knowledge base on the Open Knowledge Format v0.2. Skills to bootstrap a KB, initialize domains, ingest sources (auto-routed by domain description), search, lint, consolidate, and capture durable knowledge; a knowledge-curator agent for explicit capture; and a bundled stdlib-only Python MCP server (kb-mcp, python3 3.11+) that does the deterministic work.
